rules.description: all objects with an extension (fixtures, discovery files, assets)
keep raw files out of search, except the display assets search engines and social platforms show
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "." and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/index.html") and not (http.request.uri.path eq "/favicon.ico" or http.request.uri.path eq "/apple-touch-icon.png" or http.request.uri.path eq "/assets/og.png" or http.request.uri.path eq "/assets/mark.svg"))

((ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".html") and not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "/index.html")) or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".htm") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".xhtml") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".svg") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".xml"))

Content-Security-Policy.value: sandbox; default-src 'none'; img-src https://loremfile.dev data:; media-src https://loremfile.dev; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; font-src https://loremfile.dev
default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

rules.description: keep the pages that name the operator out of search (ADR-028)
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/legal/imprint" or http.request.uri.path eq "/legal/imprint/" or http.request.uri.path eq "/legal/privacy" or http.request.uri.path eq "/legal/privacy/")
